args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

The docstring (and FIN-212) specify banker's rounding, but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. Fix test_money.py failures in the
nightly build.

args.head: fix/money-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring already specifying banker's rounding.

## Change
- Import and apply `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `round_money`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `test_half_even`.
